title: Introduce Playbook Autopsy Mode with Sandboxed Rewind
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Adds a non-destructive 'autopsy' replay mode for incident playbooks that can step through historical executions in a sandboxed view and safely rewind simulated actions. Includes CLI + Slack blocks and DB proxy for safety.
description:
Motivation: On-call engineers need a safe way to rehearse and investigate historical incident playbooks without risking writes or accidental reruns. Autopsy mode provides a step-through replay of a past execution, attaching the original telemetry snapshots and allowing operators to mark hypotheses, annotate steps, and 'rewind' a simulated action chain for deeper diagnostic drilling.

What this PR does: Implements a non-destructive replay controller (autopsy mode) that replays recorded playbook steps against an isolated sandbox environment. Key features: 1) CLI: incident-bot replay <incident-id> --autopsy opens a guided step-through flow with confirm prompts; 2) API: new /replay/{id}?mode=autopsy endpoint that streams step events; 3) DB proxy: a read-only proxy used during replay to prevent write effects and record attempted side-effects as simulated outcomes; 4) Slack blocks and ephemeral actions for safe operator annotations and hypothesis capture; 5) Playback timeline UI payloads for the on-call console (attachments only).

Migrations: Adds replay_snapshots table (lightweight metadata + S3 pointer) and a small schema migration (20251021_replay_snapshots.sql). Migration includes backfill of latest 7 days for systems with telemetry archives; backfill optional via bin/incident-bot backfill-replay-snapshots.

Backward compatibility: Default behaviour unchanged for normal playbook runs. Autopsy mode is opt-in and gated behind the incident-bot.replay.autopsy feature flag and the incident:replay permission. Existing playbook recordings are compatible; this PR preserves the original payload format and adds a replay_metadata envelope.

Testing and QA: Unit tests for controller logic and DB proxy, integration tests exercising CLI replay and Slack flows in the e2e harness, and a manual checklist used during rollout (see docs/replay/autopsy-checklist.md). CI showed a flaky e2e that required a rerun (flaky: tests/e2e/slack_block_interaction_test).

Usage notes: To run locally: 1) ENABLE_FEATURE=incident-bot.replay.autopsy make dev-run 2) ./bin/incident-bot replay --autopsy <incident-id> 3) Use --sandbox-store to point to a test S3 prefix. See docs for recommended retention and privacy considerations.

Security and safety: The DB proxy enforces a denylist of write methods (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE are simulated and recorded rather than executed). KMS-scoped keys ensure snapshot blobs are encrypted. The UI surfaces a prominent warning banner when the mode is active.

Priya Shah: 'Acknowledged. The DB proxy now records side-effect attempts and we've added a network egress guard that replaces external HTTP calls with recorded responses when in autopsy mode. Added tests for webhook simulation (tests/integration/test_autopsy_webhook_simulation.py).'

Luca Moretti: 'Minor: please surface the feature-flag check earlier and add a log entry when someone starts autopsy replay (for audit).'

Priya Shah: 'Added audit log entry and feature flag gating; moved telemetry emit to start of controller flow.'
